subject.title: Generalize post-timeout compaction completion reconciliation across session state

question: Should OpenClaw promote the existing narrow compaction-count repair into a single compaction-completion reconciliation boundary, and which session fields or plugin/context-engine signals should that boundary own?
rationale: The remaining work crosses session storage, `/status`, token freshness, and context-engine/plugin API contracts; automation cannot safely choose that product/API boundary from source inspection alone.

options.title: Keep as design tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the reconciliation owner boundary and field/API ownership before a repair PR is attempted.

options.title: Split into narrow trackers
options.body: Close or narrow this umbrella only after preserving concrete follow-ups such as plugin-engine compaction counts and stale post-compaction token snapshots.

options.title: Limit to current counter fix
options.body: Declare the broader convergence model out of scope and rely on narrower issues for each concrete state mismatch.

recommendation.title: Keep as design tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the reconciliation owner boundary and field/API ownership before a repair PR is attempted.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the precursor counter-reconciliation fix and are the clearest history-backed routing candidate for deciding whether to broaden that seam.
